portfolio.title: AutoOPS
portfolio.description: Role-based workflow governance platform built using React Native, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and n8n automation. Enables secure workflow creation, execution, and monitoring using JWT authentication and Docker Compose deployment.

portfolio.title: Customer NLP Ticketing System
portfolio.description: Rule-based NLP ticketing system with a guided chatbot that collects user issues, detects urgency, and routes tickets to the appropriate admin automatically. Built using React Native, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and n8n automation with secure JWT authentication and Docker Compose deployment.
portfolio.link: View code (Frontend available in github profile)

portfolio.title: Infralens
portfolio.description: Data monitoring system analyzing COVID vaccination impact by comparing deaths before and after vaccination using automated workflows. If death margins exceed defined thresholds, n8n triggers high-risk email alerts with insights visualized in Tableau dashboards.

portfolio.title: Wealth Management
portfolio.description: A Next.js-based wealth management platform that allows users to manage accounts, set budgets, and track expenses efficiently. It features AI-powered receipt scanning for automatic transaction entry, interactive dashboards with expense insights, and uses Arcjet and Inngest to send monthly reports and budget alert emails when spending approaches limits.

portfolio.title: Waste Management System
portfolio.description: A TypeScript-based application that allows users to upload images of waste for AI-based verification. After verification, users receive points based on the identified waste.

portfolio.title: Restaurant Menu App
portfolio.description: A React.js-based web application that displays a restaurant menu with predefined items and pricing added manually. Developed as a beginner project to demonstrate basic component structure and user interface design.

portfolio.title: Wedding Itenary App
portfolio.description: A React.js-based front-end website that displays wedding events, locations, and a digital e-card. It also presents the details of the bride and groom in a simple and organized layout.

portfolio.title: Portfolio App
portfolio.description: A React.js-based personal portfolio website showcasing projects, technical skills, GitHub profile, and contact details. Designed with a clean and simple interface to present portfolio information effectively.
